Evidence labels

Confirmed record
A direct chain response, transaction, contract state, source-code line or dated primary document. A successful action proves use of authority, not exclusive key custody.
Derived analysis
Arithmetic, grouping or comparison of cited records. The full-hub-YES outcome and combined vAMP shares are scenarios, not observed events.
Inference / review signal
A relationship or pattern that justifies a question. Timing, payments, shared protocols and NFT collections alone do not establish ownership, coordination or motive.
Unresolved
Missing off-chain agreements, classification, historical membership or notification evidence. No evidence found in a bounded corpus is not proof of universal absence.

Original records behind the supplied website

The initial packet came from 0xphilipp-payments.pages.dev. Its source index and embedded locators were used to identify original chain, forum and GitHub records where possible. Preserved source copies remain under /record/; their original commentary is not adopted as this review’s conclusion.

  • The compiled A1–A289 record retains per-proposal ballot query URLs, transaction hashes and source hashes.
  • The packaged authority ledger retains operation-level transaction locators. The original handover lines and current roles were checked separately.
  • Every retained data artifact has a sibling .source.md describing immediate source, upstream source where established, transformation and SHA-256.
  • The supplied uncorroborated spreadsheet is not published or used as an attribution source.
  • Audit repository and provenance register
  • Phoenix Directive original governance documents
  • ERIS contracts and voting source
  • Phoenix governance forum
  • Phoenix project website

Scope and limitations

  • Evidence cutoff: 26 October 2026. Proposal 4853 remains open until 31 October at 03:40 UTC.
  • Not every packaged historical operation was independently replayed; that limitation is stated wherever the ledger is used.
  • Some bounded negative searches are limited by provider pruning and indexing. They are not chain-wide proof of absence.
  • Payment coverage and historical valuation vary by category. Gross flows are not net worth, profit or loss.
  • No identity research, surname-based searches or personal-contact calls are part of this review.

Corrections and responses

A credible review must be correctable. Cite the page, exact statement, transaction or proposal, and supporting primary source. Material responses and alternative classifications should be preserved alongside the relevant finding.
